newsitem.title: UK: UK clears Williams, Chubb Security lock-up.
newsitem.headline: UK clears Williams, Chubb Security lock-up.

text.p: Britain's Department of Trade and Industry on Monday cleared Williams Holdings Plc's planned 1.3 billion stg merger with Chubb Security Plc.
The Secretary of State for Trade and Industry said it would not refer the link-up to Britain's Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
The clearance came during the run-up to Britain's national election on Thursday, in which the poll-leading Labour Party was widely expected to oust the ruling Conservative government.
Last week, Williams said it had about 67 percent of Chubb's issued share capital under its bid, which would unite major brand names in the world security industry.
